subtitle: Instrument games, fully offline
promotional_text: An on-device teacher for four instrument games, four wooden bars, and a private band book.
description: Bandkit is a complete offline teacher for parlor instrument games. Finish onboarding, follow Walk through pluck, tap, reed, and shake, run Four Columns to lift four wooden bars, choose a Range for the round, and save a Tablet note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your round length and journal stay on the device.
app_review_notes: Bandkit is a fully offline teacher for instrument games and a private band book. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four instrument games, start Four Columns, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
